title: "DoD evidence for OMN-15413 — converge the unified application migration ledger and import historical
  state"
summary: >
  Third-party-authored DoD contract for OMN-15413, created under operator ruling R-0802-5 because no contract
  existed at all (contracts/OMN-15413.yaml returned 404 on onex_change_control, verified 2026-08-02T05:0xZ),
  so `onex skill dod_verify OMN-15413` terminated at CONTRACT_MISSING with total_checks 1 / verified 0
  and the ticket could never close. The author of this contract is NOT the implementer: OMN-15413 was
  implemented by the codex-db-domain-0729/migration-ledger lane, and this contract is authored by the
  rls-unblock-0802 lane per feedback_no_self_authored_evidence. The ticket was flipped Done 2026-07-30T16:19:12Z
  and DEMOTED to In Progress 2026-08-01 as FALSE-DONE; the demotion's decisive finding was that omnibase_infra#2557
  merged into the feature branch jonah/omn-15422-sanitized-legacy-rds-fixture rather than dev, so at flip
  time `git merge-base --is-ancestor 95351f5d origin/dev` exited 1 and dev's required check set never
  ran (3 pass / 3 skipping). Every substantive check below is therefore written as a LIVE MAINLINE READBACK
  at `?ref=dev` — the exact condition the demotion found missing — rather than against the PR head. Contract
  authorship adjudicates nothing and flips no Linear status.

dod_evidence:
  - id: "dod-omn15413-ledger-declarations-on-dev"
    description: >-
      ACCEPTANCE BULLET 1 (one canonical ledger model) and BULLET 2 (historical imports are deterministic
      and checksummed), evidenced as a LIVE MAINLINE READBACK, not a point-in-time pin. The probe fetches
      docker/migrations/forward/_ledger/application-migrations.tsv at ?ref=dev and asserts it PARSES as
      the canonical declaration manifest: every row carries exactly 6 tab-separated fields (artifact path,
      stream, owner, domain, version, checksum), every row's 6th field is a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256,
      and at least 80 rows are declared — matching the implementation report's "exact stream/owner/domain/version/SHA-256
      declarations for 80 active node artifacts". This is genuinely falsifiable in both directions and
      stays falsifiable: ?ref=dev is a mainline ref that is never deleted, so if the manifest is removed
      from dev, loses its 6-column shape, gains a non-SHA checksum, or shrinks below 80 rows, this check
      goes RED. It is NOT an immutable-commit-pin attestation and makes no frozen-true claim. Falsifiability
      was DEMONSTRATED, not asserted: raising the row floor to 5000 exits 1, and repointing the identical
      awk program at the sibling 3-column cloud-migration-aliases.tsv on the same ref exits 1 — so the
      probe reads real bytes and discriminates on real structure rather than passing vacuously. Executor
      shape — the first shlex token is `gh`, a resolvable executable; the value contains zero command
      substitution (the `$6` is an awk field reference inside a single-quoted awk program, not a shell
      expansion); the awk program accumulates a `bad` flag and decides once in END rather than calling
      `exit 1` from a rule, because an in-rule `exit` transfers to END where a second `exit` would overwrite
      the status — the exact silent always-pass this shape avoids.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"
    checks:
      - check_type: "command"
        check_value: |-
          gh api 'repos/OmniNode-ai/omnibase_infra/contents/docker/migrations/forward/_ledger/application-migrations.tsv?ref=dev' --jq .content | base64 -d | awk -F'\t' '{ if (NF != 6 || $6 !~ /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/) bad=1; n++ } END { exit (bad || n < 80) ? 1 : 0 }'

  - id: "dod-omn15413-docker-proof-attestation"
    description: >-
      ACCEPTANCE BULLET 4 — "fresh install and sanitized legacy upgrade both apply twice cleanly in rebuilt
      Docker". THIS ENTRY IS A POINT-IN-TIME ATTESTATION AND MAKES NO ONGOING-FALSIFIABILITY CLAIM — it
      is labelled as such deliberately, because the OMN-15418 contract shipped the opposite framing (an
      immutable-pin content probe named "-falsifiable") and had to be corrected add-only by OCC #5945.
      What it asserts: the ATTEMPT-1 job record of hosted run 30513583999 ("Sanitized Legacy RDS Fixture
      Proof", head 74718ff4a0be968fb857b3bace7104d8adae6bf8, created 2026-07-30T04:19:49Z) shows the single
      job "PostgreSQL 16 Fresh + Legacy Fixture" concluded `success`. Per-attempt job records are immutable
      — a re-run appends attempt N+1 and never rewrites attempt N — so this probe is frozen-true at that
      attempt and can never go RED there. That immutability is also why the attempt-anchored spelling
      is REQUIRED here rather than optional: OMN-15540 Rule F1 rejects a predicate on a bare `actions/runs/<id>`
      `.conclusion` because "Re-run jobs" rewrites it in place; the `/actions/runs/<id>/attempts/<n>/jobs`
      path is the sanctioned exempt form. The run is the one cited on the ticket by comment 33d05ad0 (2026-07-30T04:20:54Z),
      which records from that PostgreSQL 16 `--build` run: fresh application-ledger control passed twice,
      sanitized legacy application-ledger control passed twice, selected relation OID preserved, source
      ledgers immutable, all original fixture RED controls still discriminating, and cleanup passed. Falsifiability
      was demonstrated rather than asserted at the level available to an immutable record: the identical
      probe with the job-name selector changed exits 1, and pointed at that run's sibling `skipped` jobs
      it exits 1 rather than passing on empty stdout. WHY NOT RE-EXECUTED: the proof needs Docker plus
      a real PostgreSQL 16, and dod_verify runs check_values with cwd set to the onex_change_control checkout
      (OMN-14436), where neither the compose fixture nor the product tree is present.

    description: >-
      THE DEMOTION'S DECISIVE FINDING, converted into a standing check. The 2026-08-01 FALSE-DONE adjudication
      established that at the 2026-07-30T16:19:12Z Done flip the OMN-15413 content was NOT on dev: #2557's
      base branch was jonah/omn-15422-sanitized-legacy-rds-fixture, so `git merge-base --is-ancestor 95351f5d
      origin/dev` exited 1 and dev's required status-check set never ran. The content reached dev only
      on 2026-07-31T08:31:38Z via the #2547 rollup squash 675990b36a5cd018bdf3e7d1c18e876dd3dfbddb. This
      probe asserts that ancestry directly and live: comparing 675990b3...dev returns `ahead` (dev carries
      commits on top of it) or `identical`, either of which means the rollup commit is an ancestor of
      the current dev tip. It is falsifiable and stays falsifiable — if dev is ever reset behind that
      commit the comparison returns `behind` or `diverged` and this goes RED. Negative control demonstrated:
      the reverse comparison dev...675990b3 returns `behind`, so the predicate discriminates direction
      rather than passing on any two commits. The jq expression ORs two distinct status literals and never
      compares a field against its own selector, so it is not an OMN-15391 Rule C tautology.
    source: "manual"
    status: "verified"

  - id: "occ-self-bind-infra-pr-2557-merged"
    description: >-
      Product-PR self-bind for the implementation PR, written in the MERGED-ASSERTION form rather than
      the `state == "open"` form. This is deliberate and is the direct lesson of OMN-15418: that contract's
      generated `occ-self-bind-pr-5635` stamped `data['state'] == 'open'` at authoring time, the PR then
      merged, and the assertion became unsatisfiable-by-construction — a check that can never go GREEN
      again by any action on the ticket, the repo, or the product source. It was one of the two probes
      that made dod_verify refuse OMN-15418 while every product PR was already merged, and it had to be
      retired add-only. The terminal, immutable facts are asserted instead: omnibase_infra#2557 ("feat(OMN-15413):
      converge application migration ledger") is closed AND merged AND carries merge commit 95351f5d8e806fcf7fa2c276d9065df93ccf92b9.
      Falsifiability demonstrated: the identical shape with #2547's merge SHA substituted exits 1. Executor
      shape — first shlex token is `gh`, zero command substitution, consumer is `grep -Fx` redirected
      to /dev/null on fully drained input, avoiding both the `grep -q` SIGPIPE hazard and the `grep -c`
      counting idiom that fails in both polarities under pipefail. NOTE, recorded rather than glossed:
      #2557 merged into a feature branch, so its own check set was 3 pass / 3 skipping and this bind proves
      provenance of the change, not that it passed dev's gates; the mainline-arrival proof is dod-omn15413-content-on-dev-via-2547
      above.

  - id: "dod-omn15413-ac6-no-live-migration-skip"
    description: >-
      ACCEPTANCE BULLET 6 — "no live migration is applied by this ticket" — is a DISCLOSED SKIP. It carries
      status `skipped` and NO `checks` key on purpose: this is a universally-quantified negative over
      the state of every live database, and there is no probe reachable from the dod_verify executor that
      can falsify it. Every candidate encoding is a lie of a different shape. Asserting "the diff touches
      no deploy path" grades the diff, not the databases. Asserting "no migration rows were inserted"
      would need credentialed access to the prod and stability lanes, which this executor does not have
      and must not be given for an evidence read. Asserting any always-true stand-in — a grep that matches
      unconditionally, a `gh` call whose exit status does not depend on the claim — would be the vacuous
      always-true check that this contract exists to avoid, and would convert an honest unknown into a
      false GREEN. What DOES exist, recorded here as testimony and explicitly NOT as proof: the implementation
      report (ticket comment 19344393, 2026-07-30T04:17:45Z) states "No live database, deploy/restart,
      grant/RLS, cutover, history rewrite, manual ledger insertion, merge, or .201 mutation occurred",
      and comment f7543290 records that the lane's dispatch authorization prohibited live migration, database
      operation, merge, deploy, grant, RLS, and destructive action. That is the implementer's own attestation
      about their own conduct, which under feedback_no_self_authored_evidence is exactly the class of
      claim a third-party contract must not launder into a green check. This bullet is therefore reported
      as unproven by mechanism, and any Done adjudication on OMN-15413 should treat it as accepted on
      operator judgement rather than as verified.
    source: "manual"
    status: "skipped"
